model_annotation: Figure 4 illustrates a comparison of participant criteria across six different language models: Multilingual TEMs, English TEMs, Mistral, Llama3-7B, and two smaller LLMs. The horizontal axis displays the language model names, presented in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the percentage of participants, labeled as "Percentage of Participants," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels incrementing by 10. Each language model is represented by a single bar, colored in shades of blue and gray. The Multilingual TEMs bar has a height corresponding to 90%, the English TEMs bar reaches 80%, Mistral is at 70%, Llama3-7B is at 60%, and the two smaller LLMs are at 50% and 40% respectively. The Mistral bar is visually emphasized with a darker shade of blue compared to the other bars. No bars are sorted in descending order, and no annotations are present on the bars themselves.
